notes.path: Tasks/T-38 Live browser share in the Uni app so Aaron can do logins…

metadata.detail:
Design: uni:01M404CF4QKFK0TTD9NTFYZBQW (Projects/uni-app/T-38 Drive Uni's browser from the app).

Problem: when Uni's headless Chrome hits a login wall, you can only get past it by SSH or VNC.

Recommendation: option 1, a live CDP stream of Uni's own browser, with option 3's flow as its face. Uni posts a [needs login] card, you tap Open browser, log in (including 2FA), tap Done, and Uni carries on. Keep VNC as a fallback only.

1. Build it? Recommended yes.
2. Keep sessions or log out after each job? Staying logged in lets Uni act as that account on that site. The note suggests a Log out button for sensitive accounts, or a separate Uni-only account. The note gives no single recommendation here.

Security: tailnet-only, a one-time token that expires in 15 minutes, and your keystrokes never reach the model.

First check before building: whether Facebook's login page loads for headless Chrome at all. Hardware keys and passkeys will not work.
